title: Teshin's Cave/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Dummy: "Oof! Ooo! That, stung a little..."
- Teshin: "My grandfather had a saying. In a fight anger is as good as courage."
- Teshin: "The skies are burning, today. There will be conflict in your path."
- Teshin: "Do not mistake anger for petty spite. Only one of them may be righteous."
- Teshin: "Hmm. You have fire in your eyes today."
- Teshin: "Remember, only a fool seeks to stifle his anger. It is the loyal bodyguard of conscience."
- Teshin: "Trained by a Sentient over a Dax. Is it any wonder things fell out as they did? I could have done so much more."
- Teshin: "If you coveted anything in this world, Drifter, I would hope you had the courage to go and win it for yourself."
- Teshin: "Ambition braces the soul. Envy only embitters it."
- Teshin: "There is a rankness in the air today, Drifter. The sour entitlement of spoiled children."
- Teshin: "Bombastine will be abroad today. A petty man, hiding behind a mask of ingratiating smiles."
- Teshin: "Every time you leave this cave, I fear it will be the last time."
- Teshin: "Fear kills you twice: First in the mind, then only later in the body. So arm your mind well."
- Teshin: "Be hearty therefore, and cautious in your speech. For one who speaks his fear aloud to his comrades before the fight, is like unto a cupbearer, bringing poison."
- Teshin: "It is good to see you. My dreams were... not wholesome."
- Teshin: "Go out into Duviri and fear nothing you find, for the most fearsome being in all Duviri should be you."
- Teshin: "I believe the years weigh a little lighter on me, today."
- Teshin: "I woke to the sound of the shawzin. Was that you, or my dream?"
- Teshin: "A man spends his joy freely in his youth. In his old age, he must hoard what little he has left."
- Teshin: "One may chase after happiness through the fields all day like a fool, only to have it alight on one's open hand, without warning."
- Teshin: "There is too much I should have set right. The chance... will never come again."
- Teshin: "I am bound for the inn at the end of days. Death awaits me, like a faithful Yaskutai. See? The warming glass is prepared."
- Teshin: "This leaden day is too much to bear alone. Do not go solitary if you can help it, my friend."
- Teshin: "The heavy heart is all too eager to embrace wounding lies. Truth may hurt, but what hurts is not always true."
